name: Quay
summary: Quẩy is the fried breadstick Hanoi eats with most noodles. Dip it in the broth.
origin: Hanoi, where most noodle bowls take quẩy.
howToEat: Dip the breadstick in the noodle broth. Most Hanoi noodles take quẩy, miến among them.
where: With the noodle bowls, including miến at 6 Phùng Hưng, Hoàn Kiếm.
seoDescription: Quẩy in Hanoi is the fried breadstick you dip in noodle broth, including miến at 6 Phùng Hưng.
